mr_description:
Implement component highlighting on change detection cycles along with embedding
the component-specific data to the directive/component tree explorer.

expected_issues.title: console.warn() used instead of the devtools debug logger
expected_issues.description:
The new devtools backend code logs with console.warn() directly instead of the project's debugLog utility, so these messages bypass the devtools logging switch and pollute the inspected application's console.

The devtools backend runs inside the user's page; its convention is to route diagnostics through shared/utils/log (debugLog), which is silenced unless debugging is enabled. The CD analyzer and highlighter added here call console.warn() directly, so end users see devtools-internal warnings in their own application's console.
